meta.name: apify-product-lookup
meta.description: Fetch a real product's current price, stock, rating, or images from retailer pages over the Apify MCP server, and return them as typed fields rather than prose. Use when someone asks what a product costs right now, whether it is in stock, how it is rated, to compare a product across retailers, or to check a product URL they pasted. Also use when an agent would otherwise answer a product question from training data. Not for managing your own store's catalog, not for payments, and not for questions answerable without live retailer data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查商品在零售商网站的价格、库存和评分
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要给用户实时且准确的产品价格和库存信息
copy.tagline_en: Look up a product's live price, stock, rating, and images from retailers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need current product data without relying on training memory

howto.what: 当用户问到某商品当前的价格、库存或评分时，Claude 不会只凭记忆作答，而会通过 Apify 实时读取零售页面，以结构化字段返回结果，并附上商品图片链接、来源链接和读取时间。
howto.when: 当用户问到某产品当前的价格、库存或评分等实时信息时触发；也可在模型本会凭训练数据回答产品问题时使用。

say.text: 这个iPhone 15在亚马逊现在多少钱？有货吗？
say.note: 会按关键词在该平台搜索并返回价格与库存字段。

say.text: 看看这个商品链接里的东西现在卖多少钱
say.note: 会使用该商品链接返回价格等结构化数据。

say.text: 对比索尼XM5耳机在亚马逊和百思买的价格
say.note: 会分别查询两个平台并汇总展示。

howto.what_en: When asked about a product's current price, stock, or rating, Claude doesn't answer from memory. It fetches live retailer data via Apify, returns structured fields, and includes product images, source link, and read time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about a product's live price, stock, or rating—or when the model would otherwise answer from training data.

say_en.text: How much is this iPhone 15 on Amazon, and is it in stock?
say_en.note: Searches by keyword on that marketplace and returns offer/stock fields.

say_en.text: Look up the current price for the product at this link.
say_en.note: Uses the details URL to return structured price data.

say_en.text: Compare Sony XM5 headphone prices on Amazon and Best Buy.
say_en.note: Queries both marketplaces and returns a comparison.
